    end

end

    if type(combo) ~= "string" then
        return nil
    end
    local counts = { quas = 0, wex = 0, exort = 0 }
    for orb in string.gmatch(combo, "%S+") do
        if counts[orb] ~= nil then
            counts[orb] = counts[orb] + 1
        end
    end
    return counts
end

    if not state or not name then
        return
    end
    for _, slot in ipairs(state.slots) do
        if slot == name then
            return
        end
    end
    table.insert(state.slots, name)
    if #state.slots > 2 then
        table.remove(state.slots, 1)
    end
end

    local units = {}
    if not context then
        return units
    end
    if context.parent and not context.parent:IsNull() then
        table.insert(units, context.parent)
        local visuals = context.parent.__shop1_visual_dummies
        if visuals then
            for _, v in ipairs(visuals) do

            end
        end
    end
    return units

    end

    local target = unit or context.parent
    if not target or target:IsNull() then

    end

    local levels = GetInvokerLevels(context.dummy_level)
    context.special_state = context.special_state or {}
    context.special_state.invoker = context.special_state.invoker or { slots = {} }

    local wex = EnsureAbility(target, "invoker_wex", levels.wex or 1)
    local exort = EnsureAbility(target, "invoker_exort", levels.exort or 1)
    local invoke = EnsureAbility(target, "invoker_invoke", 1)

    end

    if not context or not context.parent or context.parent:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    EnsureOrbsAndInvoke(context)
end

    if not context or not context.parent or context.parent:IsNull() then
        return false
    end
    if not context.parent:IsAlive() then
        return false
    end
    if not profile or profile.is_attack then
        return false
    end
    if profile.projectile_name == "invoker_chaos_meteor" then

        profile.force_dummy_sp_origin = nil
        profile.force_dummy_sp_sync_gesture = nil
        UpdateMeteorDummySp(context, profile, pos)
    end

    local combo = ParseCombo(INVOKER_COMBOS[profile.projectile_name])
    if not combo then
        return false
    end

    local quas, wex, exort, invoke = EnsureOrbsAndInvoke(context)

    if not quas or not wex or not exort or not invoke then
        return false
    end

    local state = context.special_state and context.special_state.invoker
    if state and state.slots then
        for _, slot in ipairs(state.slots) do

                return false
            end
        end
    end

        if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
            return
        end
        if not orb or count <= 0 then
            return
        end
        for _ = 1, count do
            ExecuteOrderFromTable({

                OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_NO_TARGET,
                AbilityIndex = orb:entindex(),
                Queue = true,
            })
        end
    end

    for _, unit in ipairs(units) do
        local uq, uw, ue, uinvoke = quas, wex, exort, invoke
        if unit ~= context.parent then
            uq, uw, ue, uinvoke = EnsureOrbsAndInvoke(context, unit)
        end

            QueueOrb(unit, uq, combo.quas or 0)
            QueueOrb(unit, uw, combo.wex or 0)

        end

                OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_NO_TARGET,
                AbilityIndex = uinvoke:entindex(),
                Queue = true,
            })
        end

    end

end

        return
    end
    if profile.projectile_name ~= "invoker_chaos_meteor" then
        return
    end

end

local TAUNT_MODIFIER = "modifier_axe_berserkers_call"

local function RemoveApplied(caster, applied)
	if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
		return
	end
	if not applied then
		return
	end

	for entindex, _ in pairs(applied) do
		local unit = EntIndexToHScript(entindex)
		if unit and not unit:IsNull() then
			unit:RemoveModifierByNameAndCaster(TAUNT_MODIFIER, caster)
		end
	end
end

function AxeHandler:AfterCast(context, profile, enemy, pos, caster)
	if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
		return false
	end
	if not profile or profile.is_attack then
		return false
	end

	local ability = profile.skill
	if not ability or ability:IsNull() then
		return false
	end
	if ability:GetAbilityName() ~= "axe_berserkers_call" then
		return false
	end

	local duration = ability:GetSpecialValueFor("duration")
	local radius = ability:GetSpecialValueFor("radius")
	if duration <= 0 or radius <= 0 then
		return false
	end

	context.special_state = context.special_state or {}
	context.special_state.axe = context.special_state.axe or {}
	local state = context.special_state.axe

	state.token = (state.token or 0) + 1
	state.applied = state.applied or {}
	RemoveApplied(caster, state.applied)
	state.applied = {}

	local my_token = state.token
	local start_time = GameRules:GetGameTime()
	local end_time = start_time + duration

	Timers:CreateTimer(0, function()
		if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
			return nil
		end
		if not context.special_state or not context.special_state.axe then
			return nil
		end
		if context.special_state.axe.token ~= my_token then
			return nil
		end

		local now = GameRules:GetGameTime()
		if now >= end_time then
			RemoveApplied(caster, state.applied)
			return nil
		end

		local remaining = math.max(end_time - now, 0)
		local taunt_duration = math.min(0.6, remaining)

		local enemies = FindUnitsInRadius(
			caster:GetTeamNumber(),
			caster:GetAbsOrigin(),
			nil,
			radius,
			DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,
			DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC,
			DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_MAGIC_IMMUNE_ENEMIES,
			FIND_ANY_ORDER,
			false
		)

		for _, unit in ipairs(enemies) do
			if unit and not unit:IsNull() and unit:IsAlive() then
				unit:AddNewModifier(caster, ability, TAUNT_MODIFIER, { duration = taunt_duration })
				state.applied[unit:entindex()] = true
			end
		end

		return 0.5
	end)

	return true
end

return AxeHandler

local function EnsureAbility(unit, name, level)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return nil
    end
    local ab = unit:FindAbilityByName(name)
    if not ab then
        ab = unit:AddAbility(name)
    end
    if ab and level and level > 0 then
        ab:SetLevel(level)
        ab:SetActivated(true)
    end
    return ab
end

local function ParseAbilityCastRange(ability_kv)
    if not ability_kv then
        return 0
    end
    local cast_range = ability_kv.AbilityCastRange
    if type(cast_range) == "number" then
        return cast_range
    end
    if type(cast_range) == "string" and cast_range ~= "" then
        local first = string.match(cast_range, "[-%d%.]+")
        return tonumber(first) or 0
    end
    return 0
end

local function GetCastRange(ability, caster)
    if not ability or ability:IsNull() then
        return 0
    end
    if ability.GetCastRange then
        local range = ability:GetCastRange(caster:GetAbsOrigin(), caster)
        if range and range > 0 then
            return range
        end
    end
    return ParseAbilityCastRange(ability:GetAbilityKeyValues())
end

local function BuildTargets(caster, range)
    if not caster or caster:IsNull() or range <= 0 then
        return {}
    end
    return FindUnitsInRadius(
        caster:GetTeamNumber(),
        caster:GetAbsOrigin(),
        nil,
        range,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC,
        DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_NONE,
        FIND_CLOSEST,
        false
    )
end

local PhoenixHandler = {}

local ROOTED_MODIFIER = "modifier_rooted"

local function EnsureState(context)
    context.special_state = context.special_state or {}
    context.special_state.phoenix = context.special_state.phoenix or {}
    return context.special_state.phoenix
end

local function SaveOrigin(state, caster)
    local pos = caster:GetAbsOrigin()
    state.icarus_origin = Vector(pos.x, pos.y, pos.z)
end

function PhoenixHandler:AfterCast(context, profile, enemy, pos, caster)
    if not profile or profile.is_attack then
        return false
    end

    if profile.projectile_name == "phoenix_fire_spirits" then
        if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
            return false
        end

        local fire_spirits = profile.skill
        if not fire_spirits or fire_spirits:IsNull() then
            return false
        end

        local spirit_count = 0
        if fire_spirits.GetSpecialValueFor then
            spirit_count = fire_spirits:GetSpecialValueFor("spirit_count") or 0
        end
        if spirit_count <= 0 then
            return false
        end

        local launch = EnsureAbility(caster, "phoenix_launch_fire_spirit", fire_spirits:GetLevel())
        if not launch then
            return false
        end

        Timers:CreateTimer(0.05, function()
            if caster:IsNull() then
                return
            end
            local range = GetCastRange(launch, caster)
            if range <= 0 then
                return
            end

            local enemies = BuildTargets(caster, range)
            if #enemies == 0 then
                return
            end

            for i = 1, spirit_count do
                local target = enemies[i]
                if not target then
                    target = enemies[((i - 1) % #enemies) + 1]
                end
                if target and not target:IsNull() then
                    ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                        UnitIndex = caster:entindex(),
                        OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_POSITION,
                        AbilityIndex = launch:entindex(),
                        Position = target:GetAbsOrigin(),
                        Queue = true,
                    })
                end
            end
        end)

        return true
    end

    if profile.projectile_name == "phoenix_icarus_dive" then
        if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
            return false
        end

        local ability = profile.skill
        if not ability or ability:IsNull() then
            return false
        end

        local state = EnsureState(context)
        local token = state.icarus_token
        local origin = state.icarus_origin
        if not origin then
            return false
        end

        local duration = 0
        if ability.GetSpecialValueFor then
            duration = ability:GetSpecialValueFor("dive_duration") or 0
        end
        if duration <= 0 then
            duration = 2.0
        end

        Timers:CreateTimer(duration, function()
            if not caster or caster:IsNull() then
                return nil
            end
            local current = context.special_state and context.special_state.phoenix
            if not current or current.icarus_token ~= token then
                return nil
            end

            caster:SetOrigin(origin)
            caster:SetForwardVector(GoodForward)

            -- FindClearSpaceForUnit(caster, origin, true)
            caster:AddNewModifier(caster, nil, ROOTED_MODIFIER, {})
            return nil
        end)

        return true
    end

    return false
end

function PhoenixHandler:PrepareCast(context, profile, enemy, pos)
    if not context or not profile or profile.is_attack then
        return false
    end
    if profile.projectile_name ~= "phoenix_icarus_dive" then
        return false
    end
    if not context.parent or context.parent:IsNull() then
        return false
    end

    local state = EnsureState(context)
    state.icarus_token = (state.icarus_token or 0) + 1
    SaveOrigin(state, context.parent)

    if context.parent:HasModifier(ROOTED_MODIFIER) then
        context.parent:RemoveModifierByName(ROOTED_MODIFIER)
    end

    return true
end

return PhoenixHandler
